source.title: Repelling Invaders
source.description: Some of the Warsong Outriders lie defeated, but the battle still rages...
source.objective: Bring the Warsong Outrider Mark to Felore Moonray, Priestess of the Moon, at the Moonwell base in Ashenvale.
source.progress: <name>, what news do you have from the front?
source.completion:
These Horde invaders still sully our lands and harvest from our sacred wilderness. Continue to drive them out!

This sacred battle hymn may inspire you to fight them with greater determination. Thank you, <name>.
